changedPathRationale.server/migrations/20260910_claude_a_inte: Adds a partial unique index on initiative_candidates(organization_id, source_id), scoped to the two interview source types and non-dismissed rows, making a duplicate impossible for both the gated handoff writer and the out-of-lease scanForCandidates writer. Includes a guarded pre-reconciliation of pre-existing duplicates (already-promoted row wins, else earliest created_at; losers dismissed, never deleted; rows with initiative_id set are never touched).
changedPathRationale.server/src/services/interview/interviewC: The handoff now writes the candidate row's source_id as the INSIGHT id (not the finding id) for the 'interview_insight_finding' kind, so the same partial unique index catches duplicates from both writers despite their different source_type strings and id domains. getInterviewCandidateHandoff now resolves the downstream initiative through candidate_id instead of the receipt's source_id. Losing inserts inside the handoff are caught via a SAVEPOINT because createCandidateFromSource has no ON CONFLICT clause.
changedPathRationale.server/src/services/interviewCandidate/_: New real-Postgres proof, 11/11: both path orders converge on one row, concurrent execution converges on one row, two positive controls (single handoff still succeeds; two different insights still get their own candidate, proving the constraint is not over-scoped), gate negative, retry/replay, tenant negative, cold readback, zero orphans, and migration application over pre-seeded duplicates on a scratch database.

knownConsequences.description: scanForCandidates (cron + manual scan, outside this lane) wraps its own INSERT in a catch that does not rethrow, so a 23505 from the new index is absorbed and cannot crash the scan cron or the manual-scan route — but the cost is wasted retries until the root-cause integrator fix (unifying source_id semantics on that path) lands.

rollback.mechanism: revert the commit; the migration's index creation is additive/reversible, but its pre-existing-duplicate reconciliation (dismissing losing rows) is a data mutation a code revert does not undo — dismissed rows stay dismissed, never deleted
rollback.schemaImpact: one new partial unique index on initiative_candidates(organization_id, source_id), scoped by WHERE clause to the two interview source types and non-dismissed rows; no column changes
rollback.flagImpact: none — the fix is unconditional, not behind a runtime flag
rollback.oldReaderCompatibility: existing lookups by findingId are unaffected because the handoff receipt keeps the finding id; only the internal candidate row's source_id changed for the 'interview_insight_finding' kind. Historical source_ids are deliberately NOT rewritten, so already-accepted initiatives' lineage is undisturbed.
